title: nhrp: various fixes.
description:
List I-D draft-detienne-dmvpn-01 as documentation for what might be
considered a "Cisco extension" (the Traffic Indication packet), as it's
an I-D from people at Cisco.

Show the Traffic Code field in Traffic Indication packets.

Show all complaints about the extension offset field as expert infos
attached to that field.

When discussing the Mandatory Part of the per-packet header:

- pass dissect_nhrp_mand() a tvbuff that includes only the Mandatory
Part and doesn't include any extensions.

- use switch statements on the op type rather than a bunch of Boolean
variables.

Use the value_string table for extension types in the extension type
field, so the type's value is interpreted.
